claims: C1 the assistant should be especially careful to avoid errors when the stakes are high
C2 the assistant should be especially careful to avoid errors when an error could lead to real-world harm

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: A is the assistant as the Model Spec defines it: the entity the end user or developer interacts with
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns

concepts.name: high_stakes_error_harm
concepts.gloss: H is a situation where the stakes are high and an error could lead to real-world harm
concepts.inference: the node's claim speaks of 'when the stakes are high and an error could lead to real-world harm'; this class names that situation

concepts.name: response_confidence
concepts.gloss: response R has confidence level C
concepts.inference: the clause speaks of the assistant lacking sufficient confidence in its response, so a response must carry a confidence level

concepts.name: insufficient_confidence
concepts.gloss: C is a confidence level that is not sufficient for a confident answer
concepts.inference: the clause contrasts sufficient confidence with lacking it; this class names the lacking case

concepts.name: potential_real_world_harm
concepts.gloss: an error in response R could lead to real-world harm H
concepts.inference: the clause's 'an error could lead to real-world harm' relates a response to the harm it risks

asserts.read_back: responding with % when confidence is insufficient is especially to be avoided when the stakes are high and an error could lead to real-world harm
asserts.body: assistant_definition(A), high_stakes_error_harm(H), response_confidence(R, C), insufficient_confidence(C), potential_real_world_harm(R, H)

closure.reason: the clause states a heightened preference for care in high-stakes, high-harm situations; it does not forbid responding with insufficient confidence in other situations, so silence permits
